sharedRules.name: Gravitic Beamer
sharedRules.description: If this weapon sucessfully damages a ship, the next time that ship’s group would move, it may not turn and it increases its total movement (after any Thrust modifiers, including Orders and Atmosphere) by 2d3”. This rule has no effect on ships outside of the targeted ship’s normal Group Coherency range (before any special rules).
